llm_reason: R3 attribution: plating fixed by strong electrolyte (t+0.6/D5e-10/sigma2.0; B1 min +0.028V, B3 min +0.035V) — concentration-polarization mechanism; thickness alone (B2) does not fix plating. But B1/B3 fail T_max (350.6/342.3 K > 333.15) because the plating-free charge leg proceeds and generates heat. Direct lever: thermal management h up (forced-air 20-25 W/m2K, legitimate DOF). Risk: h up cools the cell faster in the -20C discharge -> retention must be re-verified empirically (baseline R1 at h=10 retained 99.4% with cell cooled toward ~260 K, so 95% should hold; measured values govern). Sources: h values = forced-air convection domain range; all other params carry forward from R3 (estimates as marked).
round_note: 4C exam charge leg: baseline charge only ~5-26 s (anode crash, deep-discharge start); plating-free designs charge ~90-110 s -> more heat -> T_max. T_max threshold 333.15 K is entry-0 stage3 protocol default (unchanged).
